requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access), internal communication between staff and citizens, anonymous reporting, and detailed statistics for administrators.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

domain_rules: Reports must be tied to a specific location (latitude/longitude).

Report categories are fixed: Water Supply, Architectural Barriers, Sewer System, Public Lighting, Waste, Road Signs and Traffic Lights, Roads and Urban Furnishings, Public Green Areas and Playgrounds, Other.
Photo attachment limit is 1 to 3 per report.
Rejected reports must include an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Anonymous users' names are visible to staff but hidden in the public map view.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers added by system administrator must have individual accounts.
Once a report is inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public statistics include reports by category and trends; Private statistics include detailed breakdowns (status, type, reporter).
Automatic assignment of issues is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Internal comments between technical office staff and external maintainers are reserved and not visible to citizens.
Only authenticated users (citizens) can view reports initially; unregistered users can also view reports from sprint 4 onwards.
Notifications/messages can be sent in real-time or upon page refresh based on user preference.
edge_cases: External maintainer without Participium access: Communication is out of scope; technical office updates status manually after external work is done.
Expired confirmation code (30 mins): User cannot activate account until re-registration or admin intervention.
Zooming out on map: Reports group into a cumulative view showing total count.
Downloading filtered table: Only the currently filtered subset is exported to CSV.
Following closed reports: System prevents following reports with status Resolved or Rejected.
Telegram bot commands: Specific commands (/newreport, /myreports, etc.) must be recognized and executed correctly.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central administrative body responsible for initial review and rejection explanations.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires a valid Telegram username provided by the citizen in their profile.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in the user's configuration panel.
The map layer used is strictly OpenStreetMap standard layer as per design constraints.
Automatic assignment logic applies to all issues of a category once configured, bypassing the initial review step for those categories.

risks: Ambiguity in role-based access control: endpoints like /tech_officer/reports imply specific roles but do not define how role membership is enforced beyond auth_required.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/map/accepted without providing any authentication headers. Verify that the response returns a list of accepted reports (status 'Accepted') with location data, category, and title. Ensure no private internal comments or sensitive reporter details are exposed.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per requirement PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer.
strategy_items.prompt: First, ensure a valid report exists and is in 'Accepted' status. Then, execute a PATCH request to /tech_officer/reports/{reportId}/assign_external with an authenticated token for a technical office staff member. The payload should include the external_maintainer_id obtained from /external-maintainers. Verify the assignment succeeds.
setup_needed: Create a new report via POST /reports with status 'Accepted' to satisfy dependency edges.
Retrieve a list of external maintainers via GET /external-maintainers and select one valid ID.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify the assignment was successful; if the test fails or is aborted, ensure no partial state changes remain by re-fetching the report status to confirm it hasn't been incorrectly modified.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the workflow of assigning external maintainers, a key step in requirement PT24.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to /user-registrations without authentication. The payload must include 'name', 'username', and 'email'. Verify that the system accepts the registration and returns a confirmation code or success message.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the user registration flow for citizens as per requirement PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer (Edge Case: Invalid External Maintainer).
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to /tech_officer/reports/{reportId}/assign_external with an authenticated token for a technical office staff member. The payload should include an invalid or non-existent external_maintainer_id (e.g., '99999'). Verify that the system rejects this operation with an appropriate error code (e.g., 400 or 404) indicating the maintainer does not exist.
setup_needed: Create a new report via POST /reports to satisfy the resource dependency.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the system's handling of invalid external maintainer IDs during assignment (PT24).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates status (Negative: Unauthorized Access to Unassigned Report).
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to /ext_maintainer/reports/{reportId} with an authenticated token for an external maintainer. The reportId should belong to a report that has NOT been assigned to this specific external maintainer. Verify that the system rejects this operation with a 403 Forbidden error, preventing unauthorized status updates.
setup_needed: Create a new report via POST /reports and assign it to a DIFFERENT external maintainer (or leave it unassigned) to ensure the current user cannot access it.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests security boundaries where an external maintainer tries to modify a report they are not assigned to (PT25).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Send a POST request to /verify-code with the confirmation code received during registration. Assert that the response indicates successful verification and the user session is now active.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core user onboarding flow defined in PT27.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up a new municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: First, retrieve the list of available roles via GET /roles. Then, send a POST request to /operator-registrations with a payload containing a valid role_id from the previous step and user details. Assert that the new operator is created successfully.
setup_needed: Execute GET /roles to obtain a valid role_id for the payload.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the newly created operator via DELETE /operators/{operatorId} if it was not intended to persist, or verify no resource was created if the test failed.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates PT02 while respecting the dependency on role data defined in dependency_edges.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to an existing municipality user.
strategy_items.prompt: Send a PATCH request to /operators/{operatorId}/roles with a payload specifying the desired role assignments for the operator. Assert that the roles are updated successfully on the target user.
setup_needed: Ensure an existing operator ID is available (created via PT02 or pre-existing).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Revert the role changes by sending a PATCH request with an empty roles array or null, restoring the user to their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the core functionality of PT03 for assigning roles.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new report for a citizen. Include valid latitude and longitude coordinates in the request body. Ensure the category is selected from the available list (e.g., 'Water Supply'). Use a standard citizen role token.
setup_needed: Fetch available categories via GET /categories to select a valid category_id.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of creating a geolocated report as per PT04.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports so that only valid reports are processed further.
strategy_items.prompt: Update the status of an existing report to 'Rejected' by a municipal public relations officer. Include a mandatory explanation field in the request body describing why the report was rejected.
setup_needed: Create a test report via POST /reports using a citizen token to obtain a valid reportId.
Authenticate as a municipal public relations officer.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify the report status is 'Rejected'. No deletion required by citizen, but ensure no further updates occur.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the approval/rejection workflow and mandatory explanation requirement for PT06.
